description:
Wire the cert handshake into the public MoseyClient API in clients/typescript/src/client.ts and re-export from index.ts.

Add a discriminated-union branch to the existing auth option:

  auth: { type: 'psk', secret: string, label?: string }
      | { type: 'cert', cert: Uint8Array, privateKey: Uint8Array, masterPub: Uint8Array, workspaceId: string, revoked?: Set<string> }

cert: the encoded api.Cert protobuf bytes.
privateKey: 64-byte Ed25519 private key matching the cert's peer_pubkey.
masterPub: 32-byte Ed25519 public key the verifier authenticates the server's cert against.

Validate at connect time:
- privateKey.length == 64
- masterPub.length == 32
- workspaceId non-empty
- localCert verifies against masterPub + workspaceId (fail fast on config errors, matches NewCertAuth in auth/cert.go)
- peer_pubkey in localCert matches the public half of privateKey (also matches NewCertAuth)

Expose updateRevoked(set) on the client instance for callers that want to update the revocation set without reconnecting.

Update clients/typescript/README.md: cert quickstart, remove cert auth from the 'roadmap' bullet, document the dep stance from ship-3pp.1.

Depends on ship-3pp.4.
title: TS client: public cert-auth API in MoseyClient.connect
